The '''Grimesilt Dig Site''' is a digsite once used by the [[Ironforge dwarf|Ironforge dwarves]] but was taken over and is currently still in the possession of the [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron dwarves]]. One original worker at the site, [[Dorius Stonetender]], lies injured at the bottom of the pit, and another [[Locheed|crew member]] is trapped in a nearby outhouse.

The Grimesilt Dig Site is a dwarf [[archaeology]] [[dig site]].
